## ShipmentTracker — Blazor Web App

**Architecture choices matching your requirements:**

| Requirement | Solution |
|---|---|
| Fast first load | Server-side prerendering (Auto mode) |
| Snappy after load | WebAssembly takes over — no server round-trips |
| Interactive controls everywhere | `InteractiveAuto` render mode on all pages |
| Worldwide users | WASM runs locally in-browser after download |
| Individual accounts auth | ASP.NET Core Identity with cookie auth |

**Project structure:**
- **ShipmentTracker** (server) — hosts APIs, Identity, prerendering
- **ShipmentTracker.Client** (WASM) — interactive pages run client-side
- **ShipmentTracker.Shared** — DTOs shared between server & client

**Pages:**
- `/` — **Track Shipment** (public) — customers enter tracking number, see status + delivery estimate + event history
- `/shipments` — **Dispatcher Dashboard** (requires login) — view all shipments, filter by status/destination, create new shipments, update status

**To run:**
```bash
cd ShipmentTracker/ShipmentTracker
dotnet run
```

The database is seeded with 5 sample shipments on first run.
